author: Clijmart
body:
Well, it took me a lot of thinking, but after a while I decided to go on with Avicus map making :)
Yesterday I was thinking about what to build, and today I started.
It's a mix of my 2 best maps: YinYang and SquaredNature.
The map is called CurvedDesert...

Info:
- Spectator spawn has water, people can bridge to it to get it and use it for defence or skybridge drop.
- There are 12 iron blocks in the whole map, 6 on each side, make sure to use them wisely!
- 2 monuments, one easier to defend than the other, but both not that hard if bridged to.

Authors:
Only me, {tag=32f9750efe564f7aaa981573efdc4dc2} gave me suggestions but didn't help with the building.

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/5oq35b7c1k9uwvu/CurvedDesert_%5BDTM%5D.rar
Images: http://imgur.com/a/gVytH
XML: Need Mapdev

Thanks a lot everyone who supported me and gave me feedback!
- Clijmart

replies.author: NotPineapple203
replies.body:
Really Good but,
1) You might wanna make void gap a little bigger (5 or so blocks) but thats just me

2) Spawn is pretty close to left monument, which would easily lead to stale mate, so maybe switch the houses around to try and find a balance between stalemate and EZ rush.

3) Make the monuments stick out a little more i had trouble determining which building is what

4) Maybe add a little more color to the walls but try to keep it simple the way it is.

Keep in mind these are just my suggestions that I hope you consider taking to matter. I see tons of potential in this map, and i really hope it gets accepted

replies.author: Clijmart
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for the feedback!
I thought about making the void gap bigger, but after testing with players on my own server we found out it's pretty hard to get past.
In my opinion the problem isn't it getting too stalemate, but the fact that it's too hard to defend. Players get an eff2 pick, and the spawnhouse is not breakable, which means getting back to the monument in time is quite hard.

I could add flags to show off the monuments, but I don't feel like it's that big of an issue.

The feature was the fact teams would rush to get the water sources at start of game, so they can defend and attack with it. Making it one source could ruin that plan, even though I get what you mean.

Again, thanks a lot for all the feedback you've given me. <3
